8. ⊕ row: 8 red #C00000 circles, each with a centered white '+', in one horizontal line directly below the Layer Normalization bar, one circle aligned to each of the 8 vector columns.
9. Green dashed container: one rounded rectangle, light-green #E2EFDA fill, dashed #00B050 border, enclosing both the Layer Normalization bar and the entire ⊕ row.
10. Green arrows: 8 short #00B050 up-arrows, one from the top of each ⊕ circle into the bottom edge of the Layer Normalization bar.
11. Middle vector row: 8 bars identical in style to step 6, placed below the ⊕ row; labels left-to-right Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, [Y_5?], [Y_6?], [Y_N3? — likely Y_{N-3}], [Y_N2? — likely Y_{N-2}]; 5 blue #0000CC ellipsis dots between the 6th and 7th bars.

13. Bottom vector row: 8 bars identical in style to step 6, placed below the navy block; labels left-to-right X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4, [X_5?], [X_6?], [X_N3? — likely X_{N-3}], [X_N2? — likely X_{N-2}]; 5 green #00B050 ellipsis dots between the 6th and 7th bars.
